metadata.name: avida_hil6_onehot
metadata.label: Proteomics
metadata.source: COGNANO AVIDa datasets (HuggingFace: cognano/AVIDa-hIL6, cognano/AVIDa-hTNFa, cognano/AVIDa-SARS-CoV-2). VHH (nanobody) sequences with binary binding labels against antigen variants.
metadata.description: Binary classification: predict VHH nanobody binding to one of 31 hIL6 antigen variants (wild type + 30 alanine mutants). Features: padded integer AA token IDs — VHH padded/truncated to the maximum training VHH length, Ag padded/truncated to the maximum training Ag length, then concatenated; vocab size 21 (0=PAD). All columns are categorical (cat_idx covers all).. Split: VHH-family-disjoint — VHH cores clustered with CD-HIT (identity 0.9, coverage 0.8), families assigned to train/val/test (about 70/15/15 of VHHs) by a label-balanced search, and validation/test VHHs with >= 0.9 identity to any training VHH removed; all 31 antigens occur in every split. Per-split sample caps apply.

metadata.name: avida_htnfa_onehot
metadata.label: Proteomics
metadata.source: COGNANO AVIDa datasets (HuggingFace: cognano/AVIDa-hIL6, cognano/AVIDa-hTNFa, cognano/AVIDa-SARS-CoV-2). VHH (nanobody) sequences with binary binding labels against antigen variants.
metadata.description: Binary classification: predict VHH nanobody binding to hTNFa. Single antigen — antigen features omitted. Features: padded integer AA token IDs of VHH sequence (vocab size 21, 0=PAD); padded/truncated to the maximum training VHH length. Split: CD-HIT families (identity 0.8, coverage 0.8, on the VHH core without the constant leader and His-tag) assigned to train/val/test 70/15/15 by a label-balanced local search (partition sizes and val/test positive rates matched to the overall data); VHH families never span splits.

metadata.name: avida_htnfa_3mer
metadata.label: Proteomics
metadata.source: COGNANO AVIDa datasets (HuggingFace: cognano/AVIDa-hIL6, cognano/AVIDa-hTNFa, cognano/AVIDa-SARS-CoV-2). VHH (nanobody) sequences with binary binding labels against antigen variants.
metadata.description: Binary classification: predict VHH nanobody binding to hTNFa. Single antigen — antigen features omitted. Features: TF-IDF of amino-acid 3-mers on VHH sequence only (vocabulary and IDF fitted on training rows). Split: CD-HIT families (identity 0.8, coverage 0.8, on the VHH core without the constant leader and His-tag) assigned to train/val/test 70/15/15 by a label-balanced local search (partition sizes and val/test positive rates matched to the overall data); VHH families never span splits.

metadata.name: true_melting_point
metadata.label: Proteomics
metadata.source: InstaDeepAI/true-cds-protein-tasks (Hugging Face). Original data from the Thermostability Atlas (mass spectrometry-based proteomics). Splits follow the 'mixed' split strategy from FLIP: sequences clustered at 20% identity, 80% of clusters assigned to train and 20% to test.
metadata.description: Sequence-level regression task predicting the melting temperature of proteins. Data originates from the Thermostability Atlas, compiled via a mass spectrometry-based proteomic approach. Splits follow the 'mixed' strategy from FLIP: sequences are clustered at 20% identity, with 80% of clusters assigned to train and 20% to test, avoiding over-emphasis of large clusters. The source provides coding DNA sequences (CDS); they were translated with the standard genetic code before featurization, and nonsense mutants (CDS with a premature in-frame stop codon) were removed from all splits. Features: mean-pooled ESM-2 (esm2_t12_35M_UR50D) embeddings of the translated protein.

metadata.name: true_fluorescence
metadata.label: Proteomics
metadata.source: InstaDeepAI/true-cds-protein-tasks (Hugging Face). Original data from Sarkisyan et al. — experimental study of the avGFP fitness landscape via random mutagenesis synthesized in E. coli. Split follows TAPE/PEER: train on sequences with ≤3 mutations from parent GFP, test on sequences with ≥4 mutations.
metadata.description: Sequence-level regression task predicting the log-fluorescence of higher-order mutant green fluorescent protein (avGFP) sequences. The library was generated via random mutagenesis of the wildtype sequence. Training is restricted to sequences with three or fewer mutations from parent GFP sequences; the test set contains sequences with four or more mutations, following the TAPE and PEER benchmarks. A random maximal subset of non-degenerate coding sequences was selected. The source provides coding DNA sequences (CDS); they were translated with the standard genetic code before featurization, and nonsense mutants (CDS with a premature in-frame stop codon) were removed from all splits. Features: TF-IDF of amino-acid 3-mers of the translated sequence; vocabulary (3-mers in >= 2 training sequences, top 8,000), an extra '<unk>' term for all other 3-mers, and IDF weights are fitted on the training split.

metadata.name: cptac_histology
metadata.label: Proteomics
metadata.source: CPTAC (Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium). Proteomics data from the UCEC (Uterine Corpus Endometrial Carcinoma) cohort, measured at University of Michigan (umich). Clinical labels from the MSSM (Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai) annotation.
metadata.description: Binary classification of endometrioid (0) versus serous (1) carcinoma from CPTAC UCEC tumour proteomics (umich), aligned to MSSM baseline histological annotations. One tumour profile per patient; clear-cell, mixed and unrecorded histologies are excluded. The release contains 101 patients: 80 endometrioid and 21 serous. Normal-tissue profiles and clinical annotations are excluded from the features. Missing protein measurements remain NaN; the general pipeline removes constant/all-empty columns and fits imputation/scaling within training partitions. Five stratified outer folds use three-fold inner CV for hyperparameter selection.

source_licenses.title: CPTAC UCEC proteomics and clinical annotations

Split: CD-HIT families (identity 0.8, coverage 0.8, on the VHH core without the constant leader and His-tag) assigned to train/val/test 70/15/15 by a label-balanced local search (partition sizes and val/test positive rates matched to the overall data); VHH families never span splits.

metadata.label: Proteomics
metadata.source: proteinea/solubility (Hugging Face). Binary protein solubility prediction dataset. Labels indicate whether a protein is soluble (1) or insoluble (0). Separate train, validation and test CSV files.
metadata.description: Sample-level binary classification task predicting protein solubility. Labels: 1 = soluble, 0 = insoluble. Features are k-mer (k=3) frequency vectors computed from single amino-acid sequences. Missing feature values are not imputed.

metadata.name: avida_sarscov2_3mer
metadata.label: Proteomics
metadata.source: COGNANO AVIDa datasets (HuggingFace: cognano/AVIDa-hIL6, cognano/AVIDa-hTNFa, cognano/AVIDa-SARS-CoV-2). VHH (nanobody) sequences with binary binding labels against antigen variants.
metadata.description: Binary classification: predict VHH nanobody binding to 13 antigens (12 SARS-CoV-2 spike constructs plus HCoV-OC43 as a control) under 17 antigen labels: Alpha, Beta, Delta and Omicron were screened by both bead panning (purified ectodomain, '_bead') and cell panning (full-length membrane spike, '_cell'), and bead/cell constructs have different antigen sequences. Features: [TF-IDF(VHH 3-mers) | TF-IDF(Ag 3-mers)] hstacked (vocabularies and IDF fitted on training rows). Split: COGNANO official train/test, which splits by alpaca (Alpaca P train, Alpaca C test); validation (up to 7k samples) is carved from the Alpaca P training set as whole VHH families (CD-HIT identity 0.8 on the VHH core), so no validation VHH occurs in train. After subsampling, exact (VHH sequence, antigen sequence) pairs found in test are removed from training/validation without using labels; test samples are preserved.

metadata.name: true_betalactamase_unique
metadata.label: Proteomics
metadata.source: InstaDeepAI/true-cds-protein-tasks (Hugging Face). Original data from Firnberg et al. — systematic fitness landscape of all single codon mutations in the TEM-1 Beta-lactamase gene synthesized in E. coli. Fitness measured as a weighted average of allele counts over ampicillin-concentration plates, normalised by WT fitness.
metadata.description: Sequence-level regression task predicting the fitness of all single codon substitutions in the TEM-1 Beta-lactamase gene. Labels measure the ability to confer ampicillin resistance. The Unique dataset contains a random maximal subset of non-degenerate coding sequences (one CDS per protein), using raw CDS fitness values. The source provides coding DNA sequences (CDS); they were translated with the standard genetic code before featurization, and nonsense mutants (CDS with a premature in-frame stop codon) were removed from all splits. Features: mean-pooled ESM-2 (esm2_t12_35M_UR50D) embeddings of the translated protein.

metadata.description: Retrospective four-group classification of healthy controls, skin-cancer controls, limited-radiation-toxicity controls, and acute-radiation-toxicity cases. metadata.label: Single-Cell

metadata.description: Single-cell RNA-seq of human neural organoids from the HNOCA atlas (27 publications). Task: predict the HNOCA harmonized level-4 cell-type annotation (annot_level_4_rev2) among its 30 most frequent classes. The split is donor- and publication-disjoint: groups are connected components of the publication-cell line graph and are assigned to train/val/test (train: Bhaduri, 2020; Fiorenzano, 2021; Fleck, 2022; Huang, 2021; Kanton, 2019; Kelava, 2022; Paulsen, 2022; Pellegrini, 2020; Sawada, 2020; Uzquiano, 2022; Velasco, 2019; Xiang, 2019; val: Bowles, 2021; He, 2022; test: Andersen, 2020; Atamian, 2024; Birey, 2017; Khan, 2020; Marton, 2019; Miura, 2020; Qian, 2020; Samarasinghe, 2021; Sloan, 2017; Treutlein, 2023; Trujillo, 2019; Vertesy, 2022; Yoon, 2019); then 70000/15000/15000 cells are sampled within the splits, stratified by class. Features: log1p(CPM) expression of 22000 genes selected with analytic Pearson residuals (scanpy, flavor='pearson_residuals') computed on the raw counts of the training cells only.

metadata.name: Gum1_s
metadata.label: Metabolomics
metadata.source: On the use of TabPFN on mass spectrometry analysis of volatile organic compounds. Scientific Reports (2025). GitHub: https://github.com/CIFASIS/TabPFN-VOCS
metadata.description: PTR-ToF-MS analysis of chewing gum base material (267 samples, 167 peaks, 27 batches of technical replicates). Regression: predicted value is the percentage concentration of component 1 in the base material formulation. S/P=1.60. Source PTR-ToF-MS peak values are area-normalized to a row sum of one and are retained without an additional logarithmic transformation. Feature scaling is fitted within each training partition. Five grouped outer folds test every sample exactly once. All samples sharing a source ID stay together in outer and inner CV and in the final-fit validation holdout; source IDs are split metadata, not features. Three inner folds and the final-fit holdout stratify source formulation groups by zero versus nonzero component-1 concentration.

metadata.name: PT-Mush21
metadata.label: Metabolomics
metadata.source: On the use of TabPFN on mass spectrometry analysis of volatile organic compounds. Scientific Reports (2025). GitHub: https://github.com/CIFASIS/TabPFN-VOCS
metadata.description: PTR-ToF-MS fungal species classification: 593 measurements and 383 peaks from 25 biological strains of six species, measured in pure culture and co-culture with Pseudomonas helmanticensis (Probst et al., Scientific Reports 2023). Labels 0-5 correspond to Entomortierella galaxiae, Linnemannia exigua, L. hyalina, L. sclerotiella, L. gamsii and L. solitaria. Five strain-grouped outer folds test every measurement once. The three requested inner folds reduce to two in each outer fold because of limited class support at the strain level. The final-fit validation holdout is also strain-disjoint. Sample, strain and condition identifiers are metadata, not features. Source PTR-ToF-MS peak values are area-normalized to a row sum of one and are retained without an additional logarithmic transformation. Feature scaling is fitted within each training partition.

metadata.name: MTBLS404
metadata.label: Metabolomics
metadata.description: A urine LC-MS dataset consisting of 120 named metabolites. We compare males (Class=1) and females (Class=0).

source_licenses.title: MTBLS404: Analysis of the human adult urinary metabolome variations with age, body mass index and gender by implementing a comprehensive workflow for univariate and OPLS statistical analyses. ('Sacurine' data set)

metadata.name: ST001047
metadata.label: Metabolomics
metadata.description: Urinary NMR classification of gastric cancer (GC=1; 43 samples) versus healthy controls (HE=0; 40 samples). Retain 52 of 149 source features using the CIMCB workflow criteria QC_RSD < 20% and Perc_missing < 10% from the supplied Peak sheet. Benign and quality-control samples are excluded. Feature values are log1p transformed; missing measurements are preserved for training-fitted preprocessing. The existing five stratified outer folds and three inner folds are retained. Sample IDs and source annotations are metadata, never features.

metadata.name: MTBLS136
metadata.label: Metabolomics
metadata.description: A serum LC-MS dataset consisting of 949 named metabolites. We compare estrogen plus progestin (E+P; Class=1) vs. estrogen-only (E; Class=0).

source_licenses.title: MTBLS136: Serum metabolomic profiles associated with postmenopausal hormone use

metadata.name: Noc_s
metadata.label: Metabolomics
metadata.source: On the use of TabPFN on mass spectrometry analysis of volatile organic compounds. Scientific Reports (2025). GitHub: https://github.com/CIFASIS/TabPFN-VOCS
metadata.description: PTR-ToF-MS analysis of hazelnut paste (Corylus avellana L.) from different geographical origins, roasted at varying times and temperatures (72 samples, 380 peaks, 24 batches of technical replicates). Regression: predicted value is the roasting time. S/P=0.19. Experimental details in Mazzucotelli et al. Source PTR-ToF-MS peak values are area-normalized to a row sum of one and are retained without an additional logarithmic transformation. Feature scaling is fitted within each training partition. Five grouped outer folds test every sample exactly once. All samples sharing a source ID stay together in outer and inner CV and in the final-fit validation holdout; source IDs are split metadata, not features.

metadata.name: ST001000
metadata.label: Metabolomics
metadata.description: A stool LC-MS dataset consisting of measured metabolite features. We compare CD (Class=1) and UC (Class=0) using the C18neg dataset mode.

metadata.name: QM9_g298
metadata.label: Drug Discovery
metadata.description: Geometric, energetic, electronic and thermodynamic properties of DFT-modelled small molecules. Task: predict 'g298' using Coulomb matrix features. Target: z-scored with the training-split mean and SD (stored as target_mean / target_std), following DeepChem's default target normalization for this loader. Split: random 70/15/15 (seed 42).

metadata.name: Tox21_NRAhR

metadata.name: SIDER_nervous

metadata.name: vep_pathogenic_coding
metadata.label: genomics
metadata.source: InstaDeepAI/genomics-long-range-benchmark (Hugging Face), task variant_effect_pathogenic (ClinVar, coding SNVs): ClinVar pathogenic variants vs gnomAD v3.1.2 common variants (MAF > 5%, AN >= 25,000) (Kao et al., 2024). Sequence context from the UCSC hg38 (GRCh38) reference genome.
metadata.description: Classify coding single-nucleotide variants as pathogenic (ClinVar, label 1) or common (gnomAD MAF > 5%, label 0) from DNA sequence context only. Variants are strand-canonicalised (reverse-complemented when the reference allele is a purine, so it is always C or T). Features: GRCh38 reference bases at offsets -32..+32 around the variant (the central base is the reference allele) and the alternative allele (66 categorical), plus canonical 3-mer frequencies (k-mer and reverse complement merged) of the 513-bp reference window centred on the variant (32 numeric). Allele-frequency fields, annotation fields (VEP consequence, ClinVar IDs/review status) and genomic coordinates are excluded because they define or reveal the label. chrX/chrY variants (all pathogenic by construction) and two variants listed with both labels are removed. Split by whole chromosomes: test = chr1, chr4, chr21; validation = chr5, chr6, chr11; train = remaining autosomes.

metadata.name: HIV
metadata.label: Drug Discovery
metadata.description: Experimentally measured abilities of small molecules to inhibit HIV replication. Binary classification task. Features: Morgan fingerprints (radius=2). Split: scaffold-based 70/15/15 (DeepChem ScaffoldSplitter).

metadata.name: QM9_gap
metadata.label: Drug Discovery
metadata.description: Geometric, energetic, electronic and thermodynamic properties of DFT-modelled small molecules. Task: predict 'gap' using Coulomb matrix features. metadata.name: ESOL
metadata.label: Drug Discovery
metadata.description: Water solubility data for common organic small molecules. Target: normalized log solubility (measured log solubility in mols per litre, z-scored with the training-split mean and SD, stored as target_mean / target_std). Features: Morgan fingerprints (radius=2). Split: balanced scaffold split 70/15/15 (chemprop scaffold_balanced, seed 42: scaffold sets larger than half the validation or test size are placed first, the remaining sets follow in random order, filling train, then validation, then test).

metadata.name: QSAR_biodegradation
metadata.label: drug discovery
metadata.description: Environmental ready-biodegradability classification from 41 molecular descriptors. The TALENT release contains 1,054 rows (UCI lists 1,055); collapsing three redundant descriptor rows with agreeing labels leaves 1,051 rows. Retained values are unchanged. A stratified 70/15/15 split is generated after deduplication. Molecular structures/SMILES are absent from this release, so this is a random-split descriptor benchmark, not a scaffold-generalization test. Grouped with molecular-property tasks under the benchmark drug-discovery domain.

metadata.name: Parkinson_Speech
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.source: Parkinson's Speech with Multiple Types of Sound Recordings dataset in UC Irvine ML repository, at https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/301/c+speech+dataset+with+multiple+types+of+sound+recordings
metadata.description: The PD database consists of training and test files. The training data belongs to 20 PWP (6 female, 14 male) and 20 healthy individuals (10 female, 10 male) who appealed at the Department of Neurology in Cerrahpasa Faculty of Medicine, Istanbul University. From all subjects, multiple types of sound recordings (26 voice samples including sustained vowels, numbers, words and short sentences) are taken. A group of 26 linear and time-frequency based features are extracted from each voice sample. This dataset uses only the train_data.txt file as the test data contains only positive Parkinson patients and is more like a 'clinical' test set.

source_licenses.title: Parkinson's Speech with Multiple Types of Sound Recordings

metadata.name: National_Health_and_Nutrition_Health_Survey
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: NHANES 2013-2014 age-group classification from seven predictors. RIAGENDR, PAQ605 and DIQ010 are categorical; PAQ605=7 (refused) is missing. DIQ010=3 (borderline) remains a distinct response. Age and respondent IDs are excluded. Labels and the stored TabBioMed 70/15/15 split are preserved.

source_licenses.title: National Health and Nutrition Health Survey 2013-2014 (NHANES) Age Prediction Subset

metadata.name: ecoli
metadata.label: proteomics
metadata.source: PMLB (ecoli); verified against original UCI release
metadata.description: Five-class protein subcellular localization (327 proteins, five supplied sequence-derived features: mcg, gvh, lip, alm1, alm2). Retain PMLB classes cp, im, imU, om, pp; exclude the original imL, imS and omL classes. Omit the supervised aac discriminant because its training population is unverified, and remove constant chg. Protein IDs are never features. Use five stratified outer folds and three inner folds; fit imputation, encoding and scaling within training partitions.

metadata.name: IACCD
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: Indwelling Arterial Catheter Clinical Dataset (IACCD) for 28-day mortality prediction. TabBioMed uses the separately released PhysioNet mimic2-iaccd dataset, available without credentialed access under the Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0; it does not directly access the credentialed MIMIC-II database. The whole-stay blood-gas test count (abg_count) is excluded from predictors.

source_licenses.title: Indwelling Arterial Catheter Clinical Dataset v1.0

metadata.name: metabric_grade
metadata.label: transcriptomics
metadata.description: Three-class histological grade (1, 2, 3) from primary breast-tumour gene expression in METABRIC: 1,892 distinct patients and 20,603 released expression measurements. Exclude 88 expression-profiled patients without a recorded grade. Use only the supplied log2 microarray intensities, preserving 13 missing cells for training-fitted imputation. Clinical annotations and patient/sample IDs are not features. This is a retrospective tumour molecular/pathology task. Preserve source feature-row identity even when gene annotations repeat. Use a patient-disjoint, grade-stratified 70/15/15 split (1,324/284/284); fit any additional preprocessing only on training rows.

source_licenses.title: METABRIC expression and clinical data, pinned cBioPortal release

metadata.name: audiology
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: OpenML Audiology ID 999, version 2: binary classification of the original cochlear_age diagnosis (P, encoded 1) versus all other source diagnoses (N, encoded 0). The P/N mapping is verified against the row-aligned original multiclass release, OpenML ID 7. The negative class includes other hearing disorders and normal ears. Exact duplicate feature rows with agreeing labels are collapsed before splitting; missing categorical measurements are preserved. Evaluation uses five stratified outer folds and three-fold inner cross-validation for hyperparameter selection.

metadata.name: wisconsin-breast-cancer
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic), WDBC (OpenML ID 1510, version 1), also distributed by sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer. 569 samples with 30 continuous cell-nucleus measurements extracted from digitized fine-needle aspirate images; no missing values. Binary diagnosis: 0 = benign (357), 1 = malignant (212).

metadata.name: HeartDisease_UCI
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: Heart disease classification from four pooled UCI hospital cohorts. Zero cholesterol and resting blood pressure denote missing values. Missing categorical values remain NaN; imputation is fitted during model training. The stored stratified split evaluates new patients from the pooled cohorts.

metadata.name: PatientCare
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: PatientCare dataset for binary classification (0=out, 1=in)

source_licenses.title: EHR Dataset for Patient Treatment Classification, version 1

metadata.description: Talent Benchmark dataset: Diabetic_Retinopathy_Debrecen (task=binary)

metadata.name: dermatology
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.source: PMLB (dermatology); verified against original UCI release
metadata.description: Six-way erythemato-squamous diagnosis after clinical and histopathological examination (366 patients, 34 features). Restore original UCI numeric ages instead of PMLB string-category codes; preserve eight unknown ages as NaN. The 33 other descriptors and all diagnoses match UCI exactly in row order. Use five stratified outer folds and three inner folds; fit imputation, encoding and scaling within training partitions.

metadata.name: sick
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: OpenML dataset (ID 38), relation: sick

metadata.name: MUSIC
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: MUSIC cause-of-death classification. Eleven patients lost to follow-up (exit code 1) and twenty heart-transplant patients (exit code 2) are excluded because no cause of death was observed. Class 0 is alive at the end of follow-up. Cause codes 1, 3, and 6/7 map to classes 1, 2, and 3.

metadata.name: CDC_Diabetes_Health_Indicators
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: Talent Benchmark dataset: CDC_Diabetes_Health_Indicators (task=binary). Rows from official train/val/test files are concatenated; TabBioMed then applies a 70/15/15 train/val/test split (stratified for classification, random_state=42), not the original Talent split boundaries. Exact duplicate rows were collapsed, and feature patterns with conflicting labels were dropped.

source_licenses.title: CDC BRFSS 2015 Diabetes Health Indicators, Alex Teboul distribution

metadata.name: ilpd_patient_data
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: OpenML dataset (ID 1480), relation: Indian Liver Patient Dataset

metadata.name: blood-transfusion-service
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: OpenML dataset (ID 1464), relation: blood-transfusion-service Monetary was removed because it equals 250 times Frequency. Exact duplicate rows were collapsed, and feature patterns with conflicting labels were dropped.

metadata.name: thyroid
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: Three-class UCI ANN thyroid task in TALENT row order. Released UCI feature values are restored before TALENT per-source-file z-scoring; the 15 binary flags are categorical. Standard preprocessing removes hypopituitary, constant in training, leaving 20 features (14 categorical). Labels and the stored TabBioMed 70/15/15 split are preserved. Any model scaling is fitted on its training partition.

metadata.name: Diabetes_UCI
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: UCI Diabetes 130-US Hospitals: 30-day readmission prediction at discharge. Retain the complete earliest encounter per patient, including unmeasured HbA1c/glucose; never fill fields from later encounters. Exclude discharge codes 11, 13, 14, 19, 20 and 21. Group the primary ICD-9 diagnosis and age bands; drop secondary/tertiary diagnoses, weight, payer code and identifiers. Admission type, discharge disposition and admission source are nominal categories despite their integer source codes. The general pipeline drops three constant medication columns, leaving 40 features for 69,973 distinct patients. Preserve the stored stratified 70/15/15 fixed split. Unmeasured HbA1c/glucose are explicit Not Measured categories; unknown race/specialty are explicit Missing categories. Encoding/scaling is fitted on training data.

metadata.name: spectf
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.source: PMLB (spectf); verified against original UCI release
metadata.description: Normal (0; 55) versus abnormal (1; 212) cardiac SPECT, using 44 supplied rest/stress image summaries per patient. Remove 82 redundant PMLB copies; the 267 retained records exactly match the corrected UCI train/test union. Pool that cohort for benchmark CV rather than using the UCI 80/187 split. Use five stratified outer folds and three inner folds; fit imputation, encoding and scaling within training partitions.

metadata.name: coords_1k
metadata.label: genomics
metadata.source: Chromosome data was dowloaded from GnomAD v3.1.2 - 1KG + HGDP callset: https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/downloads#v3-hgdp-1kg.         Geographical coordinates (latitude and longitude) were obtained from the harmonized gnomAD v3.1 sample metadata.
metadata.description: This dataset contains genotypes from chromosome chr22 for a subset of samples from the 1000 Genomes Project and HGDP.         For this specific dataset, 1000 SNPs at random positions were selected from the original sequences and missing values where introduced with a probability of 0%.         The task is to predict the geographical coordinates (latitude, longitude) of each sample based on the genotypes.

source_licenses.title: gnomAD v3.1.2 HGDP + 1000 Genomes callset and harmonized metadata

metadata.name: maternal_health_risk
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: Talent Benchmark dataset: maternal_health_risk (task=classification). Rows from official train/val/test files are concatenated; TabBioMed applies five stratified outer folds with three-fold inner CV, rather than the original TALENT split boundaries. Exact duplicate rows were collapsed, and feature patterns with conflicting labels were dropped.

metadata.name: pima_diabetes
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: Pima diabetes classification (OpenML 37). Zero glucose, blood pressure, skinfold thickness, insulin and BMI denote missing measurements; zero pregnancies remain valid. Imputation is fitted during model training.

metadata.name: Cardiovascular-Disease-dataset
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: TALENT/OpenML 45547 cardiovascular disease classification. Records outside fixed inclusive plausibility bounds (height 100-230 cm, weight 20-300 kg, systolic pressure 50-300 mmHg, diastolic pressure 20-200 mmHg), or with diastolic pressure greater than or equal to systolic pressure, are excluded without consulting labels or correcting values. Exact duplicate feature patterns are collapsed; patterns with conflicting labels are excluded. The retained rows use a stratified 70/15/15 train/validation/test split; original TALENT split boundaries are not retained.

metadata.name: lymphography
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: Lymphography (OpenML ID 10), restricted to metastases (1; 81 samples) versus malignant lymph (0; 61 samples). The two normal and four fibrosis cases are excluded. All 18 source features and the source row order are retained. Evaluation uses five stratified outer folds and three stratified inner folds for hyperparameter selection; preprocessing is fitted within training partitions.

metadata.name: VitalDB
metadata.label: clinical & healthcare
metadata.description: VitalDB perioperative in-hospital mortality classification using 57 features available by the end of the operative/anesthesia case. ICU stay, hospital length of stay, admission/discharge timestamps and patient/case identifiers are excluded from X. Device/procedure indicators, grouped diagnoses and perioperative durations are retained; two invalid anesthesia durations are missing. ASA and laboratory missingness are preserved for training-fitted imputation. The stored patient-grouped, outcome-stratified fixed split is unchanged: 4,442/978/968 training/validation/test cases, containing 41/9/7 mortality-positive cases (57 cases from 48 patients). The small event counts limit validation and test precision.
